decks.name: LeetCode #110 - Balanced Binary Tree
decks.description: Determine if a binary tree is height-balanced

cards.question: Balanced Binary Tree: Given a binary tree, determine if it is height-balanced. A height-balanced binary tree is a binary tree in which the depth of the two subtrees of every node never differs by more than one.

solutions.name: Brute Force
solutions.explanation: For each node, compute heights of left and right subtrees using separate height function, check if difference exceeds 1, then recursively check if subtrees are balanced. Recalculates heights repeatedly for same nodes leading to O(n²) time complexity. Simple but inefficient approach.

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Optimal DFS solution that computes height and checks balance in single pass. Return list with [balanced, height] where balanced indicates if subtree is balanced. For each node, check if both subtrees are balanced and height difference is at most 1. Efficient O(n) time with single traversal.

solutions.name: Iterative DFS
solutions.explanation: Iterative post-order DFS using stack and depths dictionary. Traverse tree in post-order ensuring children are processed before parent. Store height in depths map. When processing node, check if height difference of children exceeds 1, return false immediately if unbalanced. O(n) time and space without recursion.
